question: Which categories have the highest item value?
sql: SELECT p.product_category_name,SUM(i.price) AS item_value FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN category_translations t ON t.product_category_name=p.product_category_name GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY item_value DESC

question: Show monthly order counts.
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) AS year,EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

question: How many orders are associated with each customer state?
sql: SELECT c.customer_state,COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY c.customer_state

question: Compare recorded payments with item price plus freight for each order.
sql: WITH items_by_order AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(price+freight_value) AS items_total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id), payments_by_order AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(payment_value) AS payment_total FROM order_payments GROUP BY order_id) SELECT i.order_id,p.payment_total-i.items_total AS difference FROM items_by_order i JOIN payments_by_order p ON p.order_id=i.order_id ORDER BY i.order_id
